title.description: The title at the top of the events page.

description.defaultMessage: Our gatherings at 2255 Pillsbury Road. Everyone is welcome.
description.description: The line under the events page's title, saying what the page lists.

calendar.description: The accessible name of the calendar of events.

previousMonth.description: The accessible name of the button that moves the calendar back a month.

nextMonth.description: The accessible name of the button that moves the calendar forward a month.

today.description: The button that brings the calendar back to the current month and selects today.

day.defaultMessage: {date}, {count, plural, =0 {no events} one {# event} other {# events}}
day.description: The accessible name of a day of the calendar, which is a button that selects it. `date` is the day's date in words, already in the reader's language; `count` is how many events are held on it.

selected.description: The label over the selected day's date, above the list of the events held on that day. The date follows on its own line.

thisWeek.description: The heading over the home page's list of the current week's events, day by day.

all.description: The button under the home page's list of the week's events, leading to the events page and its calendar.

weekly.description: When an event that repeats every week is held, said under its name on its own page. `day` is the day of the week in words, already in the reader's language: “Every Sunday”.

monthly.description: When an event that repeats only in some weeks of each month is held, said under its name on its own page. `weeks` is those weeks as ordinal words, already joined in the reader's language — “first and third” — and `day` is the day of the week in words: “Every first and third Tuesday”.

week.description: Which of a month's weeks an event is held in, as an ordinal word in lowercase. It is set before a day of the week, in a list of such words: “first and third Tuesday”. `week` is a number from 1 to 5.

when.description: The label over the days and time an event is held, in the card beside the event's own page.

where.description: The label over the place an event is held, in the card beside the event's own page.

questions.description: The label over the church's phone number and email address, in the card beside an event's own page: who to ask about the event.

none.description: What the events page says when the selected day has no events.
